ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $ \triangle ABC$, $ \angle BAC=60^\circ$. If the radius $ OC$ of circle $ O$ is 2, what is the length of chord $ BC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Construct line OD $\perp$ BC at point D, \\
$\therefore \angle$ODC$=90^\circ$, BC$=2$CD,\\
$\because$ arc BC$=$ arc BC,\\
$\therefore \angle$BOC$=2\angle$BAC$=2\times 60^\circ=120^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle C= \frac{1}{2}(180^\circ-120^\circ)=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$OD$=\frac{1}{2}$CO$=1$ in $\triangle$COD,\\
$CD=\sqrt{OC^{2}-OD^{2}}=\sqrt{2^{2}-1^{2}}=\sqrt{3}$,\\
$\therefore$BC$=2\sqrt{3}$. Hence, the answer is: \boxed{2\sqrt{3}}
